the United Nations competitive examination for Arabic Translators, Editors and Verbatim Reporters. The exam is open to qualified candidates with a perfect command of Arabic, which should be their main language, and an excellent knowledge of English, and of at least one of the other official languages of the United Nations (Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish). Applications from candidates with excellent knowledge of Spanish are strongly encouraged.
